document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The ice on the streets seems disturbed. You brush against a mosaic 
of stump-like creatures leading around some of those ugly masses. 
Slaves or cattle, it appears. To carry on, go to 546; or, if you 
succeed with a Spot Hidden roll, go to 560.
(543, 546, 548, 552)
